responsibility: Implements resolution of HIR trait definitions and trait paths into TraitReference objects. It converts trait items into TraitItemReference entries, resolves type paths to trait HIR items through name-resolution mappings, builds and caches trait references including Self and generic parameter substitutions, detects recursive trait queries, computes supertrait and bound information, wires impl-associated types into trait items, and provides object-safety checks for trait items.
same_name_distinction: Implements conversion from HIR trait syntax and trait paths into cached TraitReference objects, including trait-item wrapping, path-to-trait resolution, cycle detection, substitution setup, supertrait processing, and impl-associated-type wiring. Unlike rust-hir-trait-resolve.h, this file performs trait resolution work rather than only exposing entry points.
